entries.text: Whoa! Kinda dark in here...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_01

entries.text: Arven said there’d be tons of strong Pokémon,\nso here I am![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_02

entries.text: Once she heard she’d get to battle awesome\nPokémon, she was here in a second.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_02

entries.text: You’re an annoying little pest at the academy,\nbut I guess you could come in handy for this.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_03

entries.text: Spoken like a guy who wants to get beaten\nin a battle![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_03

entries.text: But more importantly—why’s it so dark? And\nwhere’re the awesome Pokémon?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_04

entries.text: Yeah, it IS weird that the lights are off...\c\nThe last time I was here, the electricity was up\nand running. But now...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_04

entries.text: Well, NOW the lights are on![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_05

entries.text: But why?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_05

entries.text: I...I turned them on.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_01

entries.text: Seems like they were on power-saving mode.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_02

entries.text: I hacked into the system controls and overrode\nthe settings...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_03

entries.text: Oh! It’s you—the kid with the fluffy Eevee bag![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_06

entries.text: Um...I guess? My name’s Penny.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_04

entries.text:
Well, hey! We never got to actually talk!
I’m Nemona! I’m in class 1-A!\c
You must be some kind of tech whiz!\c
Do you like Pokémon battling too?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_07

entries.text: Urk. You talk, like...way too much...[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_05

entries.text: The director introduced us. When you need\nsomeone good with tech, she’s a no-brainer.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_06

entries.text: Anyway, Penny here also agreed in a second\nwhen she heard it was to help [VAR 0x0100(0000)].[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_07

entries.text:
[VAR 0xBD06(0000)]I’m not really the adventuring type...but I owe
you, [VAR 0x0100(0000)].
And
I
pay
my debts.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_06

entries.text: She’s surprisingly old-fashioned like that.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_08

entries.text: And of course everyone knows me, Arven! My\nloves include my Mabosstiff and cooking and—[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: And it seems you have gathered a group of\nformidable allies as well.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.text: And it seems you have gathered a group of\nformidable allies as well.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]
entries.label: common_1010_hakase_03b

entries.text: Uh... Sorry, who are you?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_07

entries.text: That’s...my mom.\c\nProbably...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_09a

entries.text: That’s...my dad.\c\nProbably...[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_09b

entries.text: What? That’s Professor Sada?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_08a

entries.text: What? That’s Professor Turo?![VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_08b

entries.text: Nemona. Student ID number 805C001.\nAnd Penny. Student ID number 803B121.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.text: Nemona. Student ID number 805C001.\nAnd Penny. Student ID number 803B121.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]
entries.label: common_1010_hakase_04b

entries.text: I thank you for coming.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]
entries.label: common_1010_hakase_05a

entries.text: I thank you for coming.[VAR 0x0114(000E)]
entries.label: common_1010_hakase_05b

entries.text: Of course, Professor! Oh my gosh, it’s such an\nhonor to meet you in person!\c\nI mean, maybe not “in person” exactly...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_09

entries.text: Arven, did you...uh...tell your [VAR 0x1107(00FF,0303)]momdad about us?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
entries.label: common_1010_botan_08

entries.text: When would I have done that?[VAR 0x0114(0006)]
entries.label: common_1010_friend_10

entries.text: To begin with, I’d like to ask you all to make\nyour way down into the Great Crater of Paldea.[VAR 0x0114(000B)]

entries.text: Are they...not on good terms?[VAR 0x0114(0008)]

entries.text: Must not be...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]

entries.text: I wonder if the professor’s any good at\nPokémon battling...[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_1010_rival_11

entries.text: ...Guess we’d better “proceed below,”\nas requested.[VAR 0x0114(0006)]

entries.text: Sada used to be really famous. Everyone knew\nwho she was.\c\nBut she hasn’t been in the media in, like...ages.[VAR 0x0114(0008)]
